justifications.type_expressiveness: Uses a newtype JobId, typed error enum, and separate internal/external state enums encoding retry_at in the variant, though the public JobState is forced flat by spec.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError with distinguishing UnknownId/NotRunning variants and proper Display, but new() panics via assert! and checkout uses expect() without a documented reason.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Reasonable derives and method shapes, but no doc comments on any public item, no Display for JobId/JobState, and QueueError is not marked #[non_exhaustive] nor implements std::error::Error.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, derives, pattern matching, and Option chaining reasonably, but the manual best-seq loop could be an iterator min_by_key and the payload is cloned rather than borrowed.
